summary: > Or so we hope Slain by his other Or so we hope In the chalky halls Of Academe May what lies here Never rise” —Govio's tombstone epitaph
> Govio was a resident of Duviri. He was slain by one of the Hollow Children from the Island of Academe, one of the Lost Islands of Duviri... Or so the other residents hope.
> His grave can be seen in Titan's Rest. You can read the epitaph by interacting with the tombstone.
